name: Morris Sebastian
role: Sheriff of Stark County, at Dickinson
bio: Morris Sebastian was sheriff of Stark County, based at Dickinson, and handled arrests at Medora before Billings County had its own officers. In October 1885 he returned from a successful search in Canada for stock stolen from the Gallien brothers at Belfield, which the Canadian government had confiscated and sold, and in December 1885 through March 1886 he took Medora men to Dickinson on firearms and assault charges and captured "Calamity Joe" at Glenullin. After the November 1886 election the returns gave his opponent Trask a majority of one, but the result was contested, and in December the paper reported that unless the circuit court reversed the election commissioners, Sebastian was elected by four votes.
